name: Sonnet concentrated AI/technology
strategy: Concentrated, equal-weight basket of leading AI infrastructure and platform companies expected to drive and capture the ongoing AI capex/adoption cycle through 1H26: semiconductor/compute leaders, hyperscaler cloud/AI platforms, and enterprise software beneficiaries.

orders.reason: Enterprise SaaS laggard (-33.8% H1) with weak AI monetization narrative; off-thesis for concentrated AI infra/platform mandate.
Valuation-driven drawdown (-20.3%) with high multiple risk; capital better deployed in core AI infra beneficiaries with clearer capex tailwinds.
Memory is the standout AI infra beneficiary (HBM demand from accelerators); H1 2026 strength (+187%) reflects a structural supply/demand shift likely to persist into H2.
Direct AI capex/cloud infrastructure buildout play (large RPO backlog from AI training/inference contracts) complementing hyperscaler exposure already in the book.

outlook: Expect continued AI capex-driven leadership through H2 2026, with memory/infrastructure supply constraints and cloud AI backlog conversion as key upside drivers, tempered by valuation volatility around any capex-growth deceleration signals.
